title: Cat vs Cucumbers
pitch: A jumpy cat dodges falling cucumbers that keep getting faster.
coreLoop: The cat walks along the bottom of the screen. Cucumbers spawn at random x positions at the top and fall straight down. Fall speed and spawn rate both ramp up steadily the longer the run lasts.
winLose: No win state: an endless survivor. Any cucumber touching the cat ends the run. Restart with Space, Enter or tap.
scoring: Score increases every second survived. best keeps the top score.
lookAndFeel: Bright flat-colour canvas art: an orange cat (triangle ears, circle body) and green rounded cucumbers falling from a light sky. Screen shake and a particle burst on a hit.
sound: WebAudio beeps: a soft tick on each second scored, a low thud on game over.

acceptance.text: state().speed (fall speed / spawn rate) increases as state().time increases.
A cucumber overlapping the cat sets state().scene === 'over'.
start() from the title screen moves state().scene to 'playing' with score 0.
The game runs with only ArrowLeft / ArrowRight and the on-screen touch buttons.
